Definition: to remove (a bandage from a wound, i.e. heal it)
BiblicalUsage: Gahah means to take off a bandage, to heal a wound by uncovering it. It appears once, in Hosea 5:13, where Ephraim saw his sickness and Judah saw his wound, and went to Assyria for healing — yet the Assyrian king could not heal them, nor cure them of their wound.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Assyria could not heal because the wound was God's doing; men run to kings and physicians for cures only God can give, and I hold that the healing we need most is the one that comes from the hand that wounded us.
